scope: connection test stage A (segmented monitor, attribution, UX, reports, REST)

hypothesis.claim: Probes bound to the Wi-Fi address across router, ISP hop, internet, DNS and web, with outage/spike attribution, locate where a connection fails without ever changing it
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: A probe leaves through another interface, a fault is attributed to the wrong segment, the association changes, or totals do not reconcile

decision.why: Answers 'where does it break' continuously at ~10 kbit/s without servers; owner chose A then B then C

change.summary: Domain model; WindowsConnectionProber (IcmpSendEcho2Ex with source, bound TCP/DNS/HTTPS); WlanAdapter.ReadLinkAsync (+ statistics, RSSI fallback); runner with path discovery (retry, rediscovery), gaps, stop-on-network-change; CONN-ANALYTICS-1; exports; repository schema 4; Connection test mode, drawer, stage, history, CONNECTED badge, linked saturation; /api/connection
change.scope_authority: Owner 2026-10-18: 'agree on A, B, then C'; UX choices; 'build it all'

what_worked: Scripted prober made the runner deterministic
Explicit real run with redacted output found two real-hardware defects
what_failed: SSID change missed when BSSID unchanged (fixed)
Windows TCP reset timing assumption (fixed: Refused without RTT)
ISP discovery intermittent at start-up (fixed: retry + rediscovery)
Driver lacks RSSI opcode (fixed: BSS fallback)
residual_risk: Installed build unverified on the owner's machine
ISP probing depends on provider routers

reuse.reuse_applied: Saturation-test step/hook/drawer/stage pattern; ordered writer; export helpers

lessons.transferable_rule: Run network features once on the real target machine before release; never treat elapsed time as a round trip unless the protocol guarantees one exchange

next_action.action: Owner installs 1.5.0 and runs a 15-minute connection test
